#Explore Marco Island’s natural beauty without getting tired!

##Duration
2 Hours

We will reach out to you for the exact start time and meeting time.

##About
Want to explore Marco Island’s natural beauty without getting tired? Our pedal kayaking eco-tours are perfect for you! Glide through the mangroves and wildlife effortlessly, and take in the stunning views without any distractions.

Our eco-tours are designed to be relaxing and enjoyable, providing a unique way to connect with nature. We will take you on a journey through the island’s hidden gems, giving you fascinating insights into the local ecosystem.

##Included
- First-class pedal kayaks
- Life vests
- Safety gear for a worry-free adventure

##Not Included
- Gratuities 
- Parking fee approximately $10

##What to bring
- Casual
- Comfortable athletic clothing
- Hat and light jacket
- Water shoes
- Long sleeves
- Sunblock
